segments.tha-ap546:7.3: Devo naro vā brahmā vā, paṭivattā na vijjati.
segments.tha-ap546:9.3: Guṇaṃ bahuṃ pakittetvā, etadagge ṭhapesi taṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:14.1: “‘Namo te vādimaddana [vādisaddula (sī. pī.), vādisūdana (syā.)], namo te isisattama [purisuttama (sī. pī.)];
segments.tha-ap546:14.3: Namo te sabbalokagga, namo te abhayaṅkara.
segments.tha-ap546:15.3: Namo te santisukhada, namo te saraṇaṅkara.
segments.tha-ap546:16.3: Vissāmabhūmi [vissāsaṃ bhūmi (syā.), vissānabhūmi (pī.)] santānaṃ, saraṇaṃ saraṇesinaṃ’.
segments.tha-ap546:17.3: Avocaṃ vādisūdassa [vādisūrassa (sī. syā. pī.)], gatiṃ pappomi bhikkhuno.
segments.tha-ap546:21.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap546:22.3: Vaṅgīso nāma nāmena, hessati satthu sāvako’.
segments.tha-ap546:23.1: “Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā, yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ;
segments.tha-ap546:25.1: “Pacchime ca bhave dāni, jāto vippakule [paribbājakule (sī. syā. pī.)] ahaṃ;
segments.tha-ap546:25.3: Paccājāto [sampatto ca (ka.)] yadā āsiṃ, jātiyā sattavassiko.
segments.tha-ap546:27.3: Vaṅgīso iti me nāmaṃ, abhavī lokasammataṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:28.3: Tadā rājagahe ramme, sāriputtamahaddasaṃ [mathaddasaṃ (sī. pī.), ca addasaṃ (syā.)].
segments.tha-ap546:30.3: Alolakkhiṃ mitabhāṇiṃ, yugamattaṃ nidakkhitaṃ [nirikkhataṃ (sī. pī.), udikkhataṃ (syā.)].
segments.tha-ap546:31.1: “Taṃ disvā vimhito hutvā, avocaṃ mamanucchavaṃ [mananucchavaṃ (sī. syā.)];
segments.tha-ap546:31.3: Kaṇikāraṃva nicitaṃ [kaṇikāraparicitaṃ (pī.), khaṇikaṃ ṭhānaracitaṃ (sī.)], cittaṃ gāthāpadaṃ ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:32.3: Tadā so paṇḍito vīro, uttariṃ [uttaraṃ (sī. pī.)] samavoca me.
segments.tha-ap546:35.3: Mamāha vadataṃ seṭṭho, kacci vaṅgīsa jānāsi [saccaṃ vaṅgīsa kacci te (syā.)].
segments.tha-ap546:36.5: Tava vijjāvisesena, sace sakkosi vācaya [bhāsaya (sī. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap546:39.3: Tato maṃ kabbavittosi [kavicittoti (syā. pī.)], ujjhāyantiha bhikkhavo.
segments.tha-ap546:40.3: Takkikā panimā gāthā, ṭhānaso paṭibhanti taṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:41.3: Tena hi dāni vaṅgīsa, ṭhānaso santhavāhi maṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:42.3: Ṭhānaso me tadā tuṭṭho, jino agge ṭhapesi maṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:44.3: Yathāyaṃ bhikkhu vaṅgīso, evaṃ dhāretha bhikkhavo’.
segments.tha-ap546:45.1: “Satasahasse kataṃ kammaṃ, phalaṃ dassesi me idha;
segments.tha-ap546:47.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap546:49.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā vaṅgīso thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Evaṃ thero arahattaṃ patvā attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento padumuttaro nāma jinotiādimāha.
Pabhāhi anurañjantoti so padumuttaro bhagavā nīlapītādichabbaṇṇapabhāhi raṃsīhi anurañjanto jalanto sobhayamāno vijjotamānoti attho.
Veneyyapadumāni soti padumuttarasūriyo attano vacanasaṅkhātena sūriyaraṃsiyā veneyyajanasaṅkhātapadumāni visesena bodhento pabodhento arahattamaggādhigamena phullitāni karotīti attho.
Evaṃ vuttacatuvesārajjañāṇehi sampanno samaṅgībhūto samannāgatoti attho.
Vāgīso vādisūdanoti vādīnaṃ paṇḍitajanānaṃ īso padhāno “vādīso”ti vattabbe da-kārassa ga-kāraṃ katvā evaṃ vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Sakatthaparatthavādaṃ sūdati paggharāpeti pākaṭaṃ karotīti vādisūdano.
Māramasanāti khandhamārādayo pañcamāre masati parāmasati viddhaṃsetīti māramasano.
Diṭṭhisūdanāti vohāraparamatthasaṅkhātaṃ diṭṭhidassanaṃ sūdati paggharaṃ dīpetīti diṭṭhisūdano.
Vissāmabhūmi santānanti sakalasaṃsārasāgare santānaṃ kilamantānaṃ sotāpattimaggādiadhigamāpanena vissamabhūmi vissamaṭṭhānaṃ vūpasamanaṭṭhānanti attho.
